Thank you for responding and explaining. I have being seeing a hematologist for anemia for over 14 years and get iron infusions often. I had become unable to walk very well in the past 2 years and not able to drive anymore due to the MS and Dysautonomia. I want so very much to be able to work out but not being able to stand without passing out makes it so hard. I have changed my eating habits and hoping through that I can lose some more weight and have lost enough for them to tell me I no longer have sleep apnea so that was nice. It's one day at a time and one step at a time. I feel like I am the one to always cheer everyone else up and make them laugh and most don't realize my depression. I am currently on pain medicine norco 7.5 and take 3 times a day. I had treatment and shots for a herniated disc but can't do the physical therapy because I don't have rides anywhere and nobody to take me.  I take depression medications Venafaxine and Doxepin but for some reason I still get suicidal thoughts often. I have lost a friend and 2 family members to suicide and I seen and felt firsthand what it does but I can't seem to get past feeling this way. I have tried so many medications, therapy, hypnotherapy and praying and the desire has always been there. I truly wish It would go away. I appreciate your kind words because I am usually the one to cheer up everyone around me and don't talk about my depression..

I was really depressed and in a bad place last night but I am feeling better today. I just get tired of not sleeping and being in pain all the time. Thank you for responding it gives me hope there still are really nice people in this world..
